```python
from typing import Dict, Tuple
import torch


@torch.jit.script
def compute_reward_1(root_states: torch.Tensor, actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward 1 - simple dense forward-speed reward.

    root_states layout: [pos(0:3), quat(3:7), lin_vel(7:10), ang_vel(10:13)]
    so root_states[:, 7] is the world-frame forward (+x) velocity.
    """
    # ---- forward speed of the torso (only forward motion is rewarded) ----
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(root_states[:, 7], min=0.0)

    # saturating normalisation keeps the reward bounded / well scaled
    speed_temperature = 2.0
    speed_reward = torch.tanh(forward_speed / speed_temperature)

    # ---- small control-effort penalty -> smooth, energy efficient gait ----
    control_cost_weight = 0.02
    control_cost = control_cost_weight * torch.sum(torch.square(actions), dim=1)

    reward = speed_reward - control_cost

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed_reward": speed_reward,
        "control_cost": -control_cost,
    }
    return reward, components
```

```python
def compute_reward_2(root_states: torch.Tensor, heading_vec: torch.Tensor, up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                     actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward 2 - heading-aligned speed with an upright-posture bonus.

    The ant must run fast *while staying on its feet*, so the speed term is
    projected on the horizontal heading direction and a posture term keeps the
    torso up (body up-axis vs. world +z).

    heading_speed = torch.clamp(heading_speed, min=0.0)

    speed_reward = torch.tanh(heading_speed / speed_temperature)

    # ---- posture component: keep the body upright ----------------------
    # up_vec[:, 2] ~ 1 when the body up-axis points along world +z
    upright_temperature = 2.0
    upright_reward = torch.tanh((up_vec[:, 2] + 1.0) / upright_temperature)

    control_cost_weight = 0.02
    control_cost = control_cost_weight * torch.sum(torch.square(actions), dim=1)

    upright_weight = 0.25
    reward = speed_reward + upright_weight * upright_reward - control_cost

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "heading_speed_reward": speed_reward,
        "upright_reward": upright_weight * upright_reward,
        "control_cost": -control_cost,
    }
```

```python
def compute_reward_3(root_states: torch.Tensor, potentials: torch.Tensor, prev_potentials: torch.Tensor,

                     dt: float) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward 3 - potential-based shaping + speed + smoothness penalties.

    potentials = -||target - pos|| / dt, therefore

    is the distance travelled towards the goal during the last step.
    """

    progress = (potentials - prev_potentials) * dt          # meters, >0 when approaching
    progress_temperature = 0.25
    progress_reward = torch.tanh(progress / progress_temperature)

    # ---- raw forward speed (saturating) -------------------------------
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(root_states[:, 7], min=0.0)
    speed_temperature = 2.0
    speed_reward = torch.tanh(forward_speed / speed_temperature)

    # ---- smoothness / energy penalties ---------------------------------
    dof_vel_cost_weight = 1e-4
    dof_vel_cost = dof_vel_cost_weight * torch.sum(torch.square(dof_vel), dim=1)

    control_cost_weight = 0.02
    control_cost = control_cost_weight * torch.sum(torch.square(actions), dim=1)

    progress_weight = 0.5
    reward = speed_reward + progress_weight * progress_reward - dof_vel_cost - control_cost

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "forward_speed_reward": speed_reward,
        "progress_reward": progress_weight * progress_reward,
        "dof_vel_cost": -dof_vel_cost,
        "control_cost": -control_cost,
    }
    return reward, components
```

```python
def compute_reward_4(root_states: torch.Tensor, up_vec: torch.Tensor,
                     actions: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Dict[str, torch.Tensor]]:
    """Reward 4 - non-linear 'sprint' reward with fall/crouch penalty.

    The exponential speed term plus a super-linear sprint bonus make the
    reward strongly favour large forward speeds, while the fall penalty and
    the uprightness term discourage diving to the ground to cheat the speed.

    forward_speed = torch.clamp(root_states[:, 7], min=0.0)
    forward_speed = torch.clamp(forward_speed, max=8.0)

    # ---- exponential speed reward (strongly favours fast running) ------
    speed_temperature = 2.0
    speed_reward = torch.exp(forward_speed / speed_temperature) - 1.0

    # ---- super-linear bonus above a comfortable running speed -----------
    sprint_threshold = 1.5
    sprint_weight = 0.5
    sprint_reward = sprint_weight * torch.square(
        torch.clamp(forward_speed - sprint_threshold, min=0.0))

    # ---- fall / crouch penalty (torso height drops) ---------------------
    torso_height = root_states[:, 2]
    fall_temperature = 0.25
    fall_penalty = torch.clamp(0.6 - torso_height, min=0.0) / fall_temperature

    upright_temperature = 2.0
    upright_reward = torch.tanh((up_vec[:, 2] + 1.0) / upright_temperature)
    upright_weight = 0.25

    # ---- control effort -------------------------------------------------
    control_cost_weight = 0.02
    control_cost = control_cost_weight * torch.sum(torch.square(actions), dim=1)

    reward = speed_reward + sprint_reward + upright_weight * upright_reward - fall_penalty - control_cost

    components: Dict[str, torch.Tensor] = {
        "speed_reward": speed_reward,
        "sprint_reward": sprint_reward,
        "upright_reward": upright_weight * upright_reward,
        "fall_penalty": -fall_penalty,
        "control_cost": -control_cost,
    }
    return reward, components
```
